messages:
Noah: Heads up — noticed a spike in KV cache misses + increased cross-region failovers for /v1/chat (west-eu -> us-west). Looks correlated with 'sticky-session' header dropping somewhere in the LB chain. Any ideas?

Praveen: I can repro in staging. When we do region-fallback we rewrite Host and end up dropping nonstandard headers. Proposal: add a per-route 'pass_through_headers' whitelist (default to x-redwood-session, x-client-geo). Also set an explicit 'X-Prefer-Region' override header when affinity pins a region.

Alex: Careful — passing headers through blindly could leak customer payloads. Need: strict whitelist + signing, and we must explicitly include any header used in cache keys.

Maria: Agreed on signing. Suggest edge inject HMAC header 'X-RW-Header-Sig' computed with route-specific secret. Targets verify signature and refuse unverified headers. Also ensure we never pass raw customer-sensitive values; only region/session ids.

Noah: Good. Telemetry wise we need visibility into how often headers are stripped vs passed and how many failovers they cause.

Julia: Metrics we should add: 'route.header_pass_through.count' (labels: route, header, result=pass|dropped), 'route.failover.count' (labels: route, from_region, to_region, reason), and a histogram 'failover.latency' for p50/p95/p99.

sre-oncall: Short-term mitigation: change policy to prefer-local -> same-region -> prefer-cost. Don't reassign session region unless error_rate>5% OR p95>250ms for >2m to avoid oscillation.

Praveen: Draft config prototype (staging):
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/chat",
  "geo_policy": {
    "affinity": "zone_prefer",
    "pass_through_headers": ["x-redwood-session", "x-client-geo", "x-retry-count"],
    "eject": {
      "error_rate_pct": 5,
      "p95_ms": 200,
      "window_sec": 120,
      "consecutive_windows": 2
    }
  },
  "canary": {"percent": 1, "stages": [1, 10, 100]}
}
```

Noah: Looks reasonable. Alex: we'll need an org-level consent toggle in Console to enable header passthrough for that customer's routes.

Alex: Also add audit logging whenever we propagate a header (who enabled it, when, which secret used). Routing team needs a UI for key rotation.

deploy-bot: config push to staging: geo_policy.pass_through_headers updated for /v1/chat — rollout=1% canary (internal).

Praveen: Rollout plan: 1% internal -> collect header_pass_through.count + failover.count for 24h -> if stable move to 10% -> 24h -> 100%. Add regression alert if failover.count >20% baseline.

Maria: Edge behavior: if signature verification fails, rewrite headers to safe stub (no PII) before forwarding, and increment 'header.sig_fail' metric. Do NOT forward raw header on failure.

Noah: One more: caching. As Alex said, update cache key template to include optional header bits: '{route}:{model}:{x-redwood-session|absent}:{region_pref|absent}'. Need to avoid key explosion — only include session id when present.

Julia: Add provenance logs: record source IP hash, ingress region, chosen egress region, and header propagation decision for replay/debug.

sre-oncall: Please add a short runbook step: how to quickly disable header passthrough and force local-only routing for a route in case of regression.

Praveen: I'll open the PR for config schema + unit tests and add the metric names. Will also attach sample console UI copy for the consent toggle. Link when ready.

Noah: :thumbsup: thanks all — leaving this thread.
